claim: Try it with sample data uses a separate demo storage namespace.
sandbox: fresh browser context; the exact first-screen action enters /demo, stores assist only under demo:couch-creatures:*, and survives reload

claim: A full rescue reaches a postcard with the truthful rescued total out of 12.
sandbox: fresh demo game; the public sample replay runs the normal deterministic simulation through all habitats and the UI total equals saved state

claim: Play a new route resets a completed run.
sandbox: fresh demo game; finish the public replay, restart, and assert ready phase, habitat one, zero rescued, and zero elapsed

claim: Refreshing restores an active rescue as paused.
sandbox: fresh demo game; reject a malformed save, create a valid active save, reload, and assert paused recovery without page errors

claim: Two to four local players can use keyboard and touch controls.
sandbox: fresh demo game; assert four labelled touch pairs and keyboard/touch movement for players three and four

claim: Moving hazards can end a route and the same seeded route can be retried.
sandbox: fresh demo game; public storm replay runs real collision steps to loss, then retry resets the run and keeps the seed

claim: A run has three 180-second shelter windows; missing one loses and completing all three ends near 540 seconds.
sandbox: restore the verifier's exact 180.1-second zero-ready state, assert deadline loss and retry, then run the public rescue to a 540-second postcard

claim: Demo play creates no child profile, uses only demo storage, and makes no cross-origin requests.
sandbox: record the demo play journey, assert every request is same-origin, and assert every written key uses the demo namespace

claim: Loaded shared-device play keeps working if the network drops.
sandbox: fresh dedicated browser context; load demo, set the context offline, move a lantern, and assert active local state

claim: Couch Creatures is free and exposes no ads, checkout, or purchase action.
sandbox: fresh homepage and terms route; assert the free-play statement and absence of ad, billing, checkout, and purchase UI

claim: Active play renders at least 55 frames per second at 390px under 4x CPU slowdown.
sandbox: fresh 390x844 browser context; enable 4x CPU throttling, start demo play, and measure requestAnimationFrame for three seconds

claim: A 20-minute phone room forwards concurrent moves without cursor stalls and allows eight creations per minute per connection.
sandbox: live product; pair the real controller UI, deliver 20 concurrent moves, cross the 120-move buffer, assert monotonic delivery, validate 20-minute expiry metadata and boundary logic, then assert the ninth creation is 429 with Retry-After
